scope: Complete Set 1 original 15 typography effects, one family. Set 2 omitted. Original textual content retained as design text, not scientific claims.
changes: Remote Typekit/WebFont preload removed; original CSS font stack falls back to installed system serif/sans fonts. Typography/metrics differ substantially from original licensed webfonts.
Original scroll() choreography retained verbatim; Splitting and Lenis original code retained. Initialization now sync local, wrapped owned lifecycle.
Remote analytics/sponsor scripts and external/frame navigation removed. Original content, gradients and geometric transforms retained.
Hidden unmount/reopen recreates original scene; reduced initial preference displays split text without GSAP/Lenis animation. Preference changes require reopening.
Dispose attempts every Lenis/GSAP cleanup even on error; visible abnormal cleanup state. No native pixel/scroll visual validation.
